title: The 3-Pound Rule That Keeps Belly Fat Off
hook: Maintaining your weight is far, far easier than losing weight.
body: People end up 30 pounds overweight because they stop weighing themselves. So keep weighing yourself every day, and if you ever get more than 3 pounds above your goal weight, go right back to cutting calories until it's gone. Losing 3 pounds takes a week or two. Losing 30 pounds is 90 days of sacrifice.
close: Save this for after you hit your goal.
